scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
set ACL for anonymous
    deny jcr:read on /content
end

# Who may do what on an author, out of the box. Until 27.11.2026 only admin could open the product:
# a new user read /content and nothing else, not even /libs, where the application is.
create path (sling:Folder) /libs
create path (sling:Folder) /apps
create path (sling:Folder) /conf
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content

# Everyone who is signed in reads the application, the components and the configurations.
set ACL for everyone
    allow jcr:read on /libs,/apps,/conf
end
set ACL for anonymous
    deny jcr:read on /libs,/apps,/conf
end

# Three groups, with the ids AEM uses (content packages and ACLs written for AEM name them):
#   contributor      Readers: what everyone signed in may do, as a group to put people in
#   content-authors  Authors: write, version, lock and (having jcr:write) publish everything under /content
#   administrators   Administrators: everything, the repository's own privileges included
create group contributor
create group content-authors
create group administrators
add content-authors to group contributor

set properties on authorizable(contributor)/profile
    default givenName{String} to "Readers"
    default aboutMe{String} to "Read the site, the media and the configurations. Change nothing."
end
set properties on authorizable(content-authors)/profile
    default givenName{String} to "Authors"
    default aboutMe{String} to "Create, edit, version, lock and publish pages, media and content fragments."
end
set properties on authorizable(administrators)/profile
    default givenName{String} to "Administrators"
    default aboutMe{String} to "Everything: users and permissions, publishing, maintenance, configurations."
end

set ACL for content-authors
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:lockManagement on /content
end

set ACL for administrators
    allow jcr:all on /
end
set repository ACL for administrators
    allow jcr:namespaceManagement,jcr:nodeTypeDefinitionManagement,jcr:workspaceManagement,rep:privilegeManagement
end
